mechanism_claims.claim_text: C11-Pep19-short showed bactericidal time-kill activity against Rothia kristinae at 4x MIC, with no detectable CFU after 30 min.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic killing evidence; not a molecular target assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper frames fatty-acid chain length as a determinant of antimicrobial potency, with medium-chain C10-C12 conjugates yielding the lowest MIC plateau in the tested series.
mechanism_claims.limitations: SAR and MIC evidence; does not by itself identify a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Membrane interaction/reorganization is discussed as the hypothesized mechanism based on Pep19 background literature and bacterial morphology context, not as a direct molecular assay newly performed here.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote to direct mechanism for this paper; no new membrane-disruption assay was performed in the assigned source set.

semantic_quality_control.caution: Mechanism layer is accepted as bounded phenotypic/SAR/literature-context evidence only.
